1.sql: SELECT DISTINCT "Destination" FROM sheet1 ORDER BY "Destination"

2.sql: SELECT DISTINCT "Destination" FROM sheet1 WHERE "Destination" LIKE 'South%' ORDER BY "Destination"

3.sql: SELECT MIN("Date") as min_date, MAX("Date") as max_date FROM sheet1 WHERE "Destination" LIKE 'South%'

4.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', "Date") as month, SUM("Profit") as total_profit, SUM("Total Logistics Revenue") as total_revenue, SUM("Total Logistics Cost") as total_cost, SUM("Sales Quantity") as total_qty, SUM("Discount Amount") as total_discount, COUNT(*) as order_count FROM sheet1 WHERE "Destination" LIKE 'South%' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

5.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', "Date") as month, "Consigned Product" as product, SUM("Profit") as profit, SUM("Sales Quantity") as qty, COUNT(*) as orders FROM sheet1 WHERE "Destination" LIKE 'South%' GROUP BY month, product ORDER BY product, month

6.sql: SELECT substr("Destination", 1, instr("Destination", '-')-1) as region, COUNT(DISTINCT substr("Destination", instr("Destination", '-')+1, instr(substr("Destination", instr("Destination", '-')+1), '-')-1)) as provinces FROM sheet1 WHERE "Destination" LIKE 'South%'

7.sql: SELECT DISTINCT substr("Destination", instr("Destination", '-')+1, instr(substr("Destination", instr("Destination", '-')+1), '-')-1) as province FROM sheet1 WHERE "Destination" LIKE 'South%' ORDER BY province

8.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', "Date") as month, substr("Destination", instr("Destination", '-')+1, instr(substr("Destination", instr("Destination", '-')+1), '-')-1) as province, SUM("Profit") as profit, SUM("Total Logistics Revenue") as revenue, SUM("Sales Quantity") as qty, COUNT(*) as orders FROM sheet1 WHERE "Destination" LIKE 'South%' GROUP BY month, province ORDER BY province, month

9.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', "Date") as month, SUM("Freight Cost") as freight, SUM("Warehousing Cost") as warehousing, SUM("Other Operating Costs") as other_costs, SUM("Total Logistics Cost") as total_cost, SUM("Profit") as profit FROM sheet1 WHERE "Destination" LIKE 'South%' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

10.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', "Date") as month, "Age Range" as age, SUM("Profit") as profit, SUM("Sales Quantity") as qty, COUNT(*) as orders FROM sheet1 WHERE "Destination" LIKE 'South%' GROUP BY month, age ORDER BY age, month

11.sql: SELECT "Consigned Product" as product, SUM("Profit") as profit, SUM("Sales Quantity") as qty, SUM("List Price Revenue") as list_rev, SUM("Discount Amount") as discount, SUM("Total Logistics Revenue") as rev, SUM("Total Logistics Cost") as cost FROM sheet1 WHERE "Destination" LIKE 'South%' GROUP BY product ORDER BY profit DESC

12.sql: SELECT "Date" as day, SUM("Profit") as profit, SUM("Sales Quantity") as qty, COUNT(*) as orders FROM sheet1 WHERE "Destination" LIKE 'South%' GROUP BY day ORDER BY profit DESC LIMIT 30

13.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', "Date") as month, "Customer Gender" as gender, SUM("Profit") as profit, SUM("Sales Quantity") as qty, COUNT(*) as orders FROM sheet1 WHERE "Destination" LIKE 'South%' GROUP BY month, gender ORDER BY gender, month

14.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', "Date") as month, SUM("Profit") as profit, SUM("Sales Quantity") as qty, SUM("Total Logistics Revenue") as rev, SUM("Total Logistics Cost") as cost, ROUND(SUM("Profit")*1.0/SUM("Sales Quantity"), 2) as profit_per_unit FROM sheet1 WHERE "Destination" LIKE 'South%' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

unsupported.sql: SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(("sheet1"."profit" + "sheet1"."total logistics cost") - "sheet1"."total logistics revenue") > 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

15.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as total_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(("Profit" + "Total Logistics Cost") - "Total Logistics Revenue") > 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as inconsistent, MIN("Profit") as min_profit, MAX("Profit") as max_profit, SUM(CASE WHEN "Profit" <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as non_positive_profit_rows FROM sheet1 WHERE "Destination" LIKE 'South%'

16.sql: SELECT product, COUNT(*) as n, MIN(p) as min_p, MAX(p) as max_p, ROUND(AVG(p),0) as avg_p, ROUND(SQRT(AVG(p*p) - AVG(p)*AVG(p)),0) as std_p, ROUND((SQRT(AVG(p*p) - AVG(p)*AVG(p)))/AVG(p)*100,1) as cv_pct FROM (SELECT "Consigned Product" as product, strftime('%Y-%m', "Date") as m, SUM("Profit") as p FROM sheet1 WHERE "Destination" LIKE 'South%' GROUP BY product, m) GROUP BY product ORDER BY cv_pct DESC

17.sql: SELECT province, COUNT(*) as n, MIN(p) as min_p, MAX(p) as max_p, ROUND(AVG(p),0) as avg_p, ROUND(SQRT(AVG(p*p) - AVG(p)*AVG(p)),0) as std_p, ROUND((SQRT(AVG(p*p) - AVG(p)*AVG(p)))/AVG(p)*100,1) as cv_pct FROM (SELECT substr("Destination", instr("Destination", '-')+1, instr(substr("Destination", instr("Destination", '-')+1), '-')-1) as province, strftime('%Y-%m', "Date") as m, SUM("Profit") as p FROM sheet1 WHERE "Destination" LIKE 'South%' GROUP BY province, m) GROUP BY province ORDER BY avg_p DESC

18.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(p),0) as avg_profit, ROUND(MIN(p),0) as min_profit, ROUND(MAX(p),0) as max_profit, ROUND(SQRT(AVG(p*p) - AVG(p)*AVG(p)),0) as std_profit, ROUND((SQRT(AVG(p*p) - AVG(p)*AVG(p)))/AVG(p)*100,1) as cv_pct FROM (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', "Date") as m, SUM("Profit") as p FROM sheet1 WHERE "Destination" LIKE 'South%' GROUP BY m)

19.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', "Date") as month, "Destination" as city, SUM("Profit") as profit, SUM("Sales Quantity") as qty, COUNT(*) as orders FROM sheet1 WHERE "Destination" LIKE 'South China-Guangdong%' GROUP BY month, city ORDER BY profit DESC LIMIT 60
